stem.text: An electrical cable consists of seven strands of copper wire, each of diameter $0.30\,\text{mm}$, connected in parallel.
The resistivity of copper is $1.72 \times 10^{-8}\,\Omega\,\text{m}$. The current in the cable is $13\,\text{A}$.
What is the potential difference (p.d.) between two points on the cable a distance of $1.0\,\text{m}$ apart?
